About.title: About Queenstown Local
About.description: What Queenstown Local is and where its places, events and notices come from.
About.intro: Queenstown Local puts what you need around Queenstown on one map: places to eat, drink, shop and visit, public facilities, what's on, and notices such as road works and closures.
About.audience: It is for visitors, people who live here and people who have just moved here.
About.places: Places come from the businesses' own websites and public listings. Each place shows its source and when it was last updated.
About.events: Events come from their organisers. Each event links to its official page.
About.notices: Notices summarise information from public sources such as Queenstown Lakes District Council. A notice marked Official comes from a public authority. Each notice links to its original.
About.original: Queenstown Local is not an official channel. If anything here differs from the original source, the original is right.
